title: Sebastian and the Sigil
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Jude Underhill, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
